parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve at once.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: Marks the current position to start reading from.

parameters.name: ScriptId
parameters.description: The script ID. Only common scripts are supported.

parameters.name: ScriptName
parameters.description: The name of the script. Only common scripts are supported. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: ScriptType
parameters.description:
Type of cluster script. Possible values:

- BOOTSTRAP: Bootstrap script.
- NORMAL: Regular cluster script.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr list-scripts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --next-token dd6b1b2a-5837-5237-abe4-ff0c89568980 --max-results 10 --script-type BOOTSTRAP --script-name example-string --script-id example-string --statuses example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr ListScripts --region cn-hangzhou --ScriptType BOOTSTRAP --Statuses.1 'example-string' --NextToken 'dd6b1b2a-5837-5237-abe4-ff0c89568980' --ClusterId 'c-b933c5aac8fe0000' --MaxResults 10 --ScriptName 'example-string' --ScriptId 'example-string' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
